# cursor.toml: where an expansion leaves the cursor, counted in what a user sees as a character
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== the cursor lands where the body asks
--- en_US
field: "Dear |,\nthanks "
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Dear |,\nthanks "
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Dear |,\nthanks "
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace

=== the same body picked from the palette has no delimiter to count
--- en_US
field: "Dear |,\nthanks"
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Dear |,\nthanks"
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Dear |,\nthanks"
preview: "Dear ,\nthanks"
undo: not by backspace

=== a cursor at the end leaves the caret at the end
--- en_US
field: "see you| "
preview: "see you"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "see you| "
preview: "see you"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "see you| "
preview: "see you"
undo: not by backspace

=== a pair of stops selects what is between them
--- en_US
field: "Hi [there], welcome "
preview: "Hi there, welcome"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Hi [there], welcome "
preview: "Hi there, welcome"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Hi [there], welcome "
preview: "Hi there, welcome"
undo: not by backspace

=== a second stop is ignored and says so
--- en_US
field: "a|bc"
preview: "abc"
undo: not by backspace
note: "An expansion leaves the cursor in one place. This stop is ignored."
--- de_DE
field: "a|bc"
preview: "abc"
undo: not by backspace
note: "An expansion leaves the cursor in one place. This stop is ignored."
--- ja_JP
field: "a|bc"
preview: "abc"
undo: not by backspace
note: "An expansion leaves the cursor in one place. This stop is ignored."

=== one select stop just leaves the cursor there
--- en_US
field: "a|b"
preview: "ab"
undo: not by backspace
note: "Selecting text needs two {{cursor: select}}. This one just leaves the cursor here."
--- de_DE
field: "a|b"
preview: "ab"
undo: not by backspace
note: "Selecting text needs two {{cursor: select}}. This one just leaves the cursor here."
--- ja_JP
field: "a|b"
preview: "ab"
undo: not by backspace
note: "Selecting text needs two {{cursor: select}}. This one just leaves the cursor here."

=== the cursor counts a family emoji as one character
--- en_US
field: "a|b👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
preview: "ab👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "a|b👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
preview: "ab👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "a|b👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
preview: "ab👨‍👩‍👧‍👦c"
undo: not by backspace

=== a delimiter that goes back as a key is counted once
--- en_US
field: "Dear |,\n"
preview: "Dear ,"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Dear |,\n"
preview: "Dear ,"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Dear |,\n"
preview: "Dear ,"
undo: not by backspace

=== the cursor stops where an answer ends
--- en_US
field: "Dana| — sent "
preview: "Sam — sent"
undo: not by backspace
--- de_DE
field: "Dana| — sent "
preview: "Sam — sent"
undo: not by backspace
--- ja_JP
field: "Dana| — sent "
preview: "Sam — sent"
undo: not by backspace
